target.role: Senior Manager, GRM Portfolio Risk Oversight, Business Financial Services

summary: Senior Manager, GRM Portfolio Risk Oversight, Business Financial Services candidate with ~7 years in portfolio risk analytics, stress testing, sensitivity analysis, and forward-looking scenario modelling for institutional portfolios. Holds delegated sign-off on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs across engagements of $5-25bn (~$50bn+ cumulative) at Moody's Analytics. Hands-on Python and SQL; VaR/CVaR optimization, risk decomposition, and Monte Carlo scenario generation at Ortec Finance. CFA charterholder, dual MSc in Financial Modelling and Chemical Engineering; translates complex quantitative output into committee-ready insight for senior risk and business leadership.
core_skills: Stress Testing, Scenario Analysis & Sensitivity Testing

sections.heading: Portfolio Risk Oversight & Senior Leadership Insight
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders covering rate exposure, scenario impacts, and portfolio sensitivities, translating quantitative output into investment-committee-ready narratives.
Escalated outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility and served as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

sections.heading: Stress Testing, Scenario Analysis & Sensitivity Testing
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, giving forward-looking visibility from T+1 through multi-year horizons.
Embedded behavioral cash flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays used in executive contingency planning.
Oversaw duration and interest-rate sensitivity analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks across institutional portfolios.
Validated derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, confirming consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates.

sections.heading: Risk Reporting & Analytics Tooling
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.
Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics as a member of the model governance committee.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection, cutting development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

Translated investment-team requirements into structured analytic and development requests while onboarding U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consultants onto PFaroe DB (risk analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management).
Migrated all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM, validating model outputs post-deployment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Coordinated actuarial, finance, IT, and risk functions on milestone delivery and contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.

Performed asset-only and surplus portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk attribution, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test the robustness of allocation recommendations.

Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators, applying statistical and Monte Carlo techniques to assess interest-rate exposure and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Analyzed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet exposures across portfolio studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors.
Advised clients on strategic and tactical asset allocation trade-offs through stress testing and sensitivity analysis.
Presented study findings and recommendations to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients on site.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
